en: {player}. I thought you'd come this way. Victory Road is just ahead, and the League past it.
Ever since Vaniville I've been chasing you. One more battle. Everything I've got!
That's it, then. You're the one who's going to stand in front of the Champion. Go and win.
I won? I won! Then you'd better win twice as hard up there.
I'll be cheering for you. Loudly. Embarrassingly.
Victory Road's mouth is just ahead. The guard checks your Badges.
Halt! Only a Trainer with all eight of Kalos's Badges may enter Victory Road.
Eight Badges! Very well. Victory Road is open to you, and the Pokémon League lies beyond it.
I guard the way to the League. Come back with all eight Badges of Kalos.
The League is beyond Victory Road. Good luck, Trainer.
